chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, may Allah have mercy on him, said: 'Abd Allah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa on the authority of al-Hasan ibn Mahbub on the authority of 'Abd al-'Aziz on the authority of Ibn Abu Ya'fur that Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said:

Verily, Allah is One, Alone, Sole in His Unity, Unique in His Affair. He created a creation and delegated to them the affair of His Religion, so we are that creation, O son of Abu Ya'fur! We are the Proof of Allah among His servants, and His Witnesses to His Creation, the Trustees of His Revelation, the Treasurers of His Knowledge, the Face with which He bestows [His bounties], the Eye in His creatures, the Speaking Tongue, the Embracing Heart, the Door that guides to Him, and we are those who act by His Command and call to His Path. Through us Allah was known, and through us Allah was worshipped. We are the Guides unto Allah, and were it not for us, Allah would not have been worshipped.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Proof of Allah' and trustees of His revelation according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid* articulates the Shia doctrine of *Hujjiyyat al-A'imma*, establishing the Imams as the necessary epistemological bridge for knowing and worshipping God. By describing them as God's 'tongue,' 'heart,' and 'door,' the Imam emphasizes that divine revelation and worship are mediated through their infallible authority, making them the essential proof (*Hujjah*) upon which the validity of creation's servitude depends.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 9. Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, may Allah have mercy on him, said: `Abd Allah ibn Ja`far al-Himyari on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn `Isa on the authority of alHasan ibn Mahbub on the authority of `Abd al-`Aziz on the authority of Ibn Abu Ya`fur that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:

Verily, Allah is One [Wahid], Alone [Ahad], Sole in His Unity [Mutawahhid], Unique in His Affair. He made a creatin, and authorized it in the mattes of His Religion, and we are that creation. O son of Abu Ya`fur! We are the Proof [hujjah] of Allah among His servants, and we are His Witnesses to His Creation, the Trustees of His Revelation, the Treasurers of His Knowledge, the Face with which He bestows His Bounties, the Eye with which He sees His Creatures, the Tongue with which He talks, the Heart which embraces (in love), the Door that guides to Him, the Vicegerents with His Command, and the Callers to His Path. It is due to us that Allah was recognized and due to us that Allah was worshipped. We are the Guides unto Allah. Were it not for us, Allah would not have been worshipped.
